title: Haaye Naushahe karbala qasim
body:
Haaye Naushaah E Karbala Qasim Asws.
1. Ya Quda Phool Sa Badan Tera.
Kitne Tukdo'N Mein Bant Gaya Qasim Asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Boli Ghurbat Bhi Aaj Ghurbat Ki
Hogayi Tujhpe Inteha Qasim Asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Der Aane Mein Hogayi Beta
Tujhse Sharminda Hai Chacha Qasim Asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Lab Pe Sahil Ke Aur Kumail Ke Hai
Tu Hai Naushahe Karbala Qasim Asws.
Az: Alamdar Sahil Sahab
